verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides YAML-based CI/CD workflows compatible with GitHub Actions, enabling deployment automation, and community evidence confirms real-world use of Gitea paired with CI tools (e.g., Drone) for pipelines. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of Gitea Actions specifically for deployment (most community proof uses an external CI tool like Drone rather than native Actions), and no first-party deployment-specific examples/docs beyond general CI/CD claims.
